'''''Glorius Imperica''''' was a list of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] wonders released by the [[Imperial Ministry of Education]]. It was simply a rewritten version of the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]]'s [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].
